sections.body:
RETURN POLICY
Last Updated: 13 November 2026

Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation aims to ensure that customers receive the correct books and products in good condition.

This policy applies to both Normal Orders and Pre-Orders.

 1. Eligible Returns and Replacements

Returns or replacements may be considered in the following circumstances:

- The wrong book or product has been delivered.
- The delivered book is in a different language from the language ordered.
- The product is damaged or defective before delivery due to inadequate packing or handling attributable to us.
- The customer receives an incorrect product or materially different item from the one ordered.

2. Wrong Book or Wrong Language

2.1 If a customer receives a book in a language different from the language ordered, we will replace it at no additional cost.

2.2 The customer must notify us within 3 days of receiving the book.

2.3 The customer must provide photographs of the book received and the order confirmation.

2.4 The incorrectly supplied copy must be returned in unused condition.

2.5 Return courier charges for an incorrectly supplied book will be borne by us.

 3. Damaged Products

3.1 Customers must report damage within 48 hours of delivery.

3.2 Customers are requested to provide an unboxing video, photographs of the damaged product and photographs of the outer packaging.

3.3 We will review the complaint and determine the appropriate resolution.

3.4 If damage is attributable to inadequate packing by us, we will arrange a replacement without additional product or shipping charges.

3.5 Where damage is attributable to courier handling, we will assist the customer in coordinating with the courier partner and raising a claim wherever applicable.

 4. Non-Eligible Returns

Returns will generally not be accepted for:

- Books that have been used, written in, marked, torn or damaged by the customer.
- Products damaged after delivery due to improper handling or storage by the customer.
- Products returned without prior approval.
- Change of mind or incorrect orders placed by the customer.

These exclusions are subject to applicable consumer protection laws and do not restrict statutory customer rights.

 5. Normal Orders

5.1 Return or replacement requests for Normal Orders must be submitted within the applicable reporting period.

5.2 Products must be returned in their original unused condition wherever a return is approved.

5.3 Our customer support team will communicate the return procedure and applicable shipping arrangements.

 6. Pre-Orders

6.1 Once a Pre-Order is dispatched, the same return and replacement conditions applicable to Normal Orders will apply.

6.2 Before dispatch, customers may request cancellation in accordance with our Cancellation Policy.

6.3 A delay in product availability will be governed by the cancellation and refund provisions applicable to Pre-Orders.

 7. Return Approval

All return and replacement requests must be reported to and approved by our customer support team before the product is sent back.

Customers should not independently dispatch products to our address without receiving return instructions.

 8. Contact Us

Email: care@vaidyagogate.org  
Phone: 8668904067

Please mention your Order ID in all communications.

REFUND POLICY
Last Updated: 13 November 2026

Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation aims to process eligible refunds transparently and within a reasonable timeframe.

This policy applies to all Normal Orders and Pre-Orders placed through our website.

 1. General Refund Conditions

1.1 Refunds will be processed after the relevant cancellation, return or refund request has been reviewed and approved.

1.2 Approved refunds will generally be credited to the original payment method.

1.3 Refunds will normally be initiated within approximately 8 working days of the cancellation or refund request being accepted.

1.4 Banks, UPI applications and payment providers may require additional time to credit the refunded amount.

 2. Refunds for Normal Orders

Refunds may be considered in the following circumstances:

- The order is cancelled before dispatch.
- We are unable to fulfil the order.
- The ordered product is unavailable.
- A return or replacement complaint is approved for a refund.
- We cancel the order for operational or other valid reasons.

 3. Refunds for Pre-Orders

3.1 A booking amount is collected when placing a Pre-Order to reserve the customer's copy.

3.2 The booking amount forms part of the total price of the book and is not an additional charge.

3.3 If the customer cancels a Pre-Order before dispatch, the amount paid will be refunded after deducting the applicable non-refundable platform fee.

3.4 If we are unable to supply the pre-ordered product, the entire amount paid, including the platform fee, will be refunded.

3.5 If the availability of a pre-ordered book is delayed by more than 30 days beyond the announced availability date, the customer may cancel the order and receive a full refund, including the platform fee.

3.6 If the customer chooses to continue with the Pre-Order despite the delay, the order will remain subject to the revised availability communication.

### 4. Platform Fee

4.1 A platform fee may be applicable to orders placed through our website.

4.2 For customer-initiated cancellations before dispatch, the platform fee is non-refundable.

4.3 If we cancel an order or are unable to supply the product, the full amount paid, including the platform fee, will be refunded.

4.4 Any refund required under applicable consumer protection laws will be processed in accordance with those laws.

 5. Shipping and Packaging Charges

5.1 Shipping and packaging charges for successfully dispatched orders are generally non-refundable for customer-initiated cancellations or returns, except where required by law or where the issue is attributable to us.

5.2 If we cancel an order before dispatch because we cannot fulfil it, the full amount collected will be refunded.

5.3 Where an incorrect product is supplied or damage is attributable to our packing, applicable return and replacement shipping charges will be borne by us.

 6. Refund Processing

6.1 Refunds will be initiated through the original payment channel wherever possible.

6.2 Customers may be required to provide their Order ID and payment transaction reference for verification.

6.3 We do not control the processing timelines of banks, UPI applications or third-party payment providers.

 7. Non-Receipt of Refund

If an approved refund has not been credited within the expected period, customers may contact us with:

- Order ID.
- Payment transaction ID.
- Date of payment.
- Refund confirmation, if available.

8. Contact Us

Email: care@vaidyagogate.org  
Phone: 8668904067

We aim to acknowledge refund-related complaints within 48 hours and resolve them as soon as reasonably possible.

sections.body:
CANCELLATION POLICY
Last Updated: 13 November 2026

This Cancellation Policy explains how customers may cancel Normal Orders and Pre-Orders placed through the Vaidya Gogate Memorial Foundation website.

 1. Normal Orders

1.1 Customers may request cancellation of a Normal Order before it is dispatched.

1.2 Once an order has been handed over to the courier partner for dispatch, cancellation may no longer be possible.

1.3 Customers must contact customer support with their Order ID to request cancellation.

1.4 Cancellation requests will be reviewed and confirmed by our team.

 2. Pre-Orders

2.1 Customers may request cancellation of a Pre-Order before the book or product is dispatched.

2.2 The booking amount paid at the time of ordering forms part of the total product price.

2.3 If a customer cancels a Pre-Order before dispatch, the amount paid will be refunded after deducting the applicable non-refundable platform fee.

2.4 If we are unable to supply the pre-ordered product, the full amount paid, including the platform fee, will be refunded.

 3. Delay in Product Availability

3.1 If the availability of a pre-ordered book is delayed due to printing, binding, supply, transportation or other circumstances, we will inform customers as soon as reasonably possible.

3.2 If the delay exceeds 30 days beyond the announced availability date, customers may choose to cancel their Pre-Order.

3.3 In such cases, the customer will receive a full refund, including the booking amount and platform fee.

3.4 Customers who choose to continue with their Pre-Order will be informed of the revised expected availability date.

 4. Cancellation by the Foundation

We reserve the right to cancel an order in circumstances including:

- Product unavailability.
- Inability to fulfil the order.
- Incorrect or incomplete product information.
- Pricing or technical errors.
- Suspected fraudulent transactions.
- Operational circumstances preventing fulfilment.

If we cancel an order or are unable to supply the product, the full amount paid, including the platform fee, will be refunded.

 5. Refund After Cancellation

5.1 Approved cancellation refunds will generally be initiated within approximately 8 working days after cancellation is accepted.

5.2 Refunds will be made to the original payment method wherever possible.

5.3 Banks and payment providers may require additional processing time.

 6. How to Request Cancellation

Customers can submit cancellation requests through:

Email: care@vaidyagogate.org  
Phone: 8668904067

Please provide your Order ID, registered mobile number and reason for cancellation.

7. Important Note

A cancellation request is subject to review and confirmation by our customer support team.

Nothing in this policy restricts rights available to customers under applicable Indian consumer protection laws.
